message:
{
  "verdict": "escalate",
  "summary": "The front matches the approved concept closely and every assertion passes, but the back is a plain leather vest panel instead of crossing harness straps. The brief names those straps as an identity mark, and the front-only concept doesn't show a back, so no single concept edit or reroll is sure to fix it.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "check": "concept_match",
      "severity": "major",
      "observation": "Harness straps don't cross the back. From behind, the harness is one solid dark reddish-brown vest panel from the shoulders to the mid-back, with only a strap edge over the right shoulder and a doubled belt at the waist. The brief (silhouette and identity marks) asks for 'harness straps crossing the back', and the camera sits behind the player. The approved concept shows only the front, so the multiview stage made up the back.",
      "evidence": "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-3/04_back.png, assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-3/09_closeup_back.png, assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-3/01_approved_concept.png"
    },
    {
      "check": "malformed",
      "severity": "minor",
      "observation": "Besides the 4,713-triangle body, the mesh has four small separate parts (two about 6.8 x 2.9 x 1.4 cm, two about 2 x 1.4 x 2.5 cm). They are probably buckles or eye pieces, but they can't be picked out in the renders. There are also 13 non-manifold edges and 2 boundary loops, which is within the hole limit.",
      "evidence": "metrics.mesh.parts, metrics.mesh.non_manifold_edges, assertion 'holes (welded boundary loops)'"
    },
    {
      "check": "malformed",
      "severity": "minor",
      "observation": "The hands are modelled with separate fingers, which is fine detail this 5,000-face budget may not hold well once rigged. They look intact in the renders.",
      "evidence": "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-3/05_top.png, assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-3/06_clay_front.png"
    }
  ],
  "escalation_reason": "The only major finding is that the harness straps don't cross the back, which the brief names as an identity mark. The approved concept shows only the front, so this isn't generator noise against the concept: the back was never specified. refine_concept can't show a back on a front-only image, and a reroll isn't sure to produce back straps. The user should decide how to fix it: accept the vest back, add a back view or reference to the concept or multiview input, or reroll the multiview and hope.",
  "questions_answered": [
    "Present: spiky dark hair, collared deep dark teal tunic with a front slit that flares at the knee-length hem, dark reddish-brown leather vest with two straps crossing the chest, belt, near-black bracers at the wrists, dark trousers, dark reddish-brown boots with folded cuffs, empty hands, T-pose. Changed: from behind, the harness is a solid vest panel with no crossing straps (images 04, 09); the concept shows only the front.",
    "No holes beyond the 2 boundary loops, no fused limbs, spikes or extra props. Four tiny separate parts (2 to 7 cm) that can't be picked out in the renders, 13 non-manifold edges, and separate fingers. All minor.",
    "Yes: 4,893 of 5,500 triangles, one 256x256 albedo, height 1.8 m against a 1.8 m target.",
    "Yes, all color assertions pass (hue/saturation distance after correction is 1.3 or less on every checked color). No concept color was lost. The teal renders as the concept's navy-teal #14313F, as approved. No large area is in a color the brief doesn't ask for.",
    "Eyes: clearly present, with brows. Nose: present, though faint (shading only). Mouth: faint, a thin line. The concept shows the same features and the mesh keeps them."
  ],
  "images_seen": [
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-3/01_approved_concept.png",
    "assets/manifests/judge_replays/player_mesh/judge/model-3/02_front.png",

  ]
